reason: The current GRURec achieves macro validation HR@10=0.5737, but compressing persistent interests into its recurrent state remains a plausible limitation. Historical history-pooling experiments support testing explicit prefix information, while sampled-softmax and separate candidate embeddings failed to improve the reference, favoring retention of tied embeddings and the existing objective. Modify model_design for a causal prefix-mean feature and training_evaluation for compatible checkpoint deployment and controlled verification, without changing data processing.

plan.model_design: Extend GRURec.encode with a jointly trained causal prefix-mean feature computed from the existing self.embedding(seq) before input normalization or dropout: explicitly zero padding embeddings, accumulate sums in float32 along the sequence dimension, and divide by cumulative nonpadding counts clamped to at least one. Normalize this mean using a new self.prefix_norm = nn.LayerNorm(dim), zero positions with no observed items after normalization, concatenate it with the raw GRU output, and apply self.prefix_fusion = nn.Linear(2 * dim, dim), initialized with weights [I, 0] and zero bias so the initial fused representation equals the existing recurrent state. Pass the result through the unchanged self.dropout, self.projection, and final L2 normalization, explicitly masking padded output positions; this tests persistent-interest retention without the masking complexity of attention or separate candidate representations. Preserve GRURec.__init__(itemnum, dim=96, maxlen=128, dropout=0.25), encode(seq), score(features, candidates), predict(seq, candidates), existing attribute names and output shapes, two-layer self.gru, tied self.embedding, self.bias, and self.log_scale. Keep the independent positive/negative softplus objective and produce scores solely through the existing jointly trained scoring head.
plan.training_evaluation: Preserve Histories sampling, chronological truncation, right padding, last-valid-state selection, NEGATIVES=8, uniform sampling and target-collision handling, AdamW settings, LR, batch size, steps, mixed precision, clipping, EPOCHS default 200 with its environment override, deadlines, and 25-epoch early stopping with HR@10 selection and NDCG@10 tie-breaking to isolate the architecture change. Update checkpoint metadata with an architecture-version field separate from constructor arguments and update write_predict_script() to validate that version, reconstruct the augmented GRURec from checkpoint['meta'], and strictly load its complete state_dict, preserving train_category(name, device, deadline), write_predict_script(), and predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None). Before sustained training, run lightweight checks for correct masked prefix means, invariance of earlier features to future-token changes in evaluation mode, finite outputs and gradients for empty and single-item histories under mixed precision, initial fusion equivalence, and prediction parity after checkpoint reload, without additional training runs. Retain fixed validation with evaluation seed 42, 200 users per category and 99 unique negatives, and compare actual pinned-host macro HR@10 and all four category scores against 0.5737 and the supplied category references, treating host evaluation as authoritative. Preserve supplied splits, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four DATASETS and routes, trial-local WORK artifacts, single-GPU execution, and the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget; train from scratch and load exactly one selected checkpoint per category without averaging, auxiliary fitted scorers, other-trial checkpoint reuse, or hidden-test access.
